instruction: 根据用户问题生成SQL查询语句

instruction: 根据用户问题生成SQL查询语句
input: 金花股份利润总额大于平均值的报告期
output: SELECT report_period, total_profit FROM income_sheet WHERE stock_abbr = '金花股份' AND total_profit > (SELECT AVG(total_profit) FROM income_sheet WHERE stock_abbr = '金花股份');

instruction: 根据用户问题生成SQL查询语句
input: 金花股份各报告期负债占资产比例的变化
output: SELECT report_period, liability_total_liabilities, asset_total_assets, ROUND((liability_total_liabilities / asset_total_assets) * 100, 2) as liability_asset_ratio FROM balance_sheet WHERE stock_abbr = '金花股份' ORDER BY report_period;

instruction: 根据用户问题生成SQL查询语句
input: 金花股份各类费用占营业收入的比例
output: SELECT report_period, total_operating_revenue, operating_expense_selling_expenses, operating_expense_administrative_expenses, ROUND((operating_expense_selling_expenses + operating_expense_administrative_expenses) / total_operating_revenue * 100, 2) as fee_ratio FROM income_sheet WHERE stock_abbr = '金花股份' ORDER BY report_period;

instruction: 根据用户问题生成SQL查询语句
input: 金花股份应收账款和存货占总资产的比例
output: SELECT report_period, asset_accounts_receivable, asset_inventory, asset_total_assets, ROUND((asset_accounts_receivable + asset_inventory) / asset_total_assets * 100, 2) as working_capital_ratio FROM balance_sheet WHERE stock_abbr = '金花股份' ORDER BY report_period;

instruction: 根据用户问题生成SQL查询语句
input: 金花股份经营现金流与净利润的关系
output: SELECT i.report_period, i.net_profit, c.operating_cf_net_amount FROM income_sheet i JOIN cash_flow_sheet c ON i.stock_abbr = c.stock_abbr AND i.report_period = c.report_period WHERE i.stock_abbr = '金花股份' ORDER BY i.report_period;

instruction: 根据用户问题生成SQL查询语句
input: 金花股份利润质量分析
output: SELECT i.report_period, i.net_profit, c.operating_cf_net_amount, ROUND(c.operating_cf_net_amount / i.net_profit, 2) as quality_ratio FROM income_sheet i JOIN cash_flow_sheet c ON i.stock_abbr = c.stock_abbr AND i.report_period = c.report_period WHERE i.stock_abbr = '金花股份' AND i.net_profit > 0 ORDER BY i.report_period;

instruction: 根据用户问题生成SQL查询语句
input: 金花股份扣非净利润的可持续性分析
output: SELECT report_period, net_profit_excl_non_recurring, net_profit_excl_non_recurring_yoy FROM core_performance_indicators_sheet WHERE stock_abbr = '金花股份' ORDER BY report_period;

instruction: 根据用户问题生成SQL查询语句
input: 金花股份股东权益与净资产收益率的关系
output: SELECT b.report_period, b.equity_total_equity, c.roe FROM balance_sheet b JOIN core_performance_indicators_sheet c ON b.stock_abbr = c.stock_abbr AND b.report_period = c.report_period WHERE b.stock_abbr = '金花股份' ORDER BY b.report_period;

instruction: 根据用户问题生成SQL查询语句
input: 金花股份研发投入与利润增长的关系
output: SELECT i.report_period, i.operating_expense_rnd_expenses, i.total_profit, c.total_operating_revenue FROM income_sheet i JOIN core_performance_indicators_sheet c ON i.stock_abbr = c.stock_abbr AND i.report_period = c.report_period WHERE i.stock_abbr = '金花股份' ORDER BY i.report_period;
